reviews.text:
Super dog sitter! My 5-year-old, 4.2 kg Coton de Tulear just spent 3 days and 2 nights with Angélique this week for the first time.

I found Sweetie in great shape, relaxed, and with a new toy because it was her birthday on Thursday!
I HIGHLY RECOMMEND ++

Excellent dog sitter: very dedicated! Angélique looked after our one-and-a-half-year-old corgi yesterday, and the day went very well. She kept us regularly updated on how our dog was doing. Very professional.

I wholeheartedly agree with all the glowing reviews above. Angélique is a rare and invaluable pet sitter who will treat your dogs as if they were her own. Having witnessed her work on several occasions, I can attest to this. The dogs are so expressive and happy with her. Woof woof woof woof slurp slurp!

Everything went very well with Jazz and Angélique! She was very communicative and sent lots of photos of Jazz. Being quite elderly, Jazz has many specific needs, and she took excellent care of him. I know she was there with him, and they spent a lot of time outdoors together. I highly recommend her!

We entrusted Sunshine to Angélique this summer, and we couldn't have dreamed of a better pet sitter!

We regularly use Angélique's services. We are reassured by her kindness, her professionalism, and above all, by her love for animals. Angélique didn't just look after Sunshine; she truly treated him like her own dog.

Sunshine was so comfortable with her that it was clear he felt happy, confident, and completely at home. It's a real joy to know your companion is in such good hands when you have to be away.

We also greatly appreciated the updates and attention she gave him while we were gone. You can really tell that Angélique does this with heart and that she creates a genuine bond with the animals she cares for.

An exceptional pet sitter—gentle, caring, and trustworthy—whom we recommend without hesitation!

Thank you again, Angélique, for taking such good care of our Sunshine!

★★★★★

We entrusted our cocker spaniel to Angélique and we are so glad we found her! 🐶❤️

Angélique is lovely, very gentle, and above all, extremely caring with animals. She took perfect care of our cocker spaniel, respecting his routine and giving him lots of affection. You can immediately tell that she truly loves animals and cares deeply about their well-being.

We also really appreciated the updates and little touches while we were away, which allowed us to go on vacation with complete peace of mind. It's so reassuring to know that your dog is in good hands!

Our cocker spaniel was in great shape and happy when we returned.

My little dog was 11 years old, and I was very stressed about leaving him with someone other than my family for the first time, but from our very first meeting, I immediately felt comfortable with Angelique and her mother. My dog's stay went very well (one week). He enjoyed lovely walks and lots of cozy time on the sofa and bed. We received beautiful photos and regular updates, which reassured us that he was settling in well (not easy at his age) and thoroughly enjoying his stay. I thank Angelique for taking such good care of our old boy! And of course, I recommend her without hesitation.
Angelique took excellent care of Nell. It was a real holiday with walks and cuddles. We found her in great shape. We will definitely use her pet-sitting services again.

Angelique is truly a wonderful person. She is reliable and kind to dogs, and also knows how to walk them safely! My former dog, Blacky, and now Lula, were welcomed with love and understanding! Thank you, Angelique!

After six years, I returned to Paris and asked Angelique to look after my Balduccio. Angelique had been excellent with my basset hound Rino and has proven to be extraordinary with Balduccio, who is young, enthusiastic, and very active. Thank you so much, Angelique, for your invaluable help, just as you did six years ago.
